personality_one_liner: A calm, magazine-grade archive for web links with metadata extraction, folders, and on-device privacy.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room with magazine-style padding and clean horizontal rhythm

do's: Use clean editorial dividers and warm paper textures
Rely on typography hierarchy and generous negative space
dont's: No heavy SaaS drop shadows or glossy gradients
No neon colors or synthetic borders

screens.name: HomeFeed
screens.purpose: Display all saved links in a clean editorial feed with search, folder filtering, and metadata previews.

states.loading: Centered warm spinner with subtle pulse animation
states.empty: Warm paper illustration, 'No links archived yet', and 'Add your first link' primary CTA button
states.error: Readable notice with a retry button to reload local storage

screens.layout: Sticky top bar with app title and quick share/paste button, search bar with filter chips for folders, followed by vertical list of editorial link cards with domain, title, description, and tags.

screens.name: AddLinkModal
screens.purpose: Manually paste URLs or receive shared URLs via Android Sharesheet with automatic metadata extraction.

states.loading: Extracting page title, description, and preview image indicator
states.empty: Empty URL input field with a 'Paste from Clipboard' shortcut button
states.error: URL validation error banner with instructions

screens.layout: Modal sheet with URL input, real-time metadata preview card (title, extracted image, domain), folder selector dropdown, and tag input field.

screens.name: FoldersScreen
screens.purpose: Organize saved links into customized folders and categories.

states.empty: Icon illustration with 'No folders created' and '+ New Folder' CTA
states.error: Folder load error message with retry button

screens.layout: Grid of folder cards displaying item counts, thumbnail collage, and custom color tags, with a floating action button for creating new folders.

screens.name: LinkDetailScreen
screens.purpose: View full extracted article metadata, notes, tags, and open or share the link.

states.loading: Header shimmer effect with loading state for metadata
states.empty: Fallback view with basic domain and URL display

screens.layout: Editorial header image with gradient scrim, title in Playfair Display, domain pill badge, editable personal notes section, folder and tag pills, and sticky bottom action bar for Open, Share, and Edit.

screens.name: SettingsScreen
screens.purpose: Manage on-device storage, data export/import, and app preferences with zero account required.

states.loading: Static render with local storage stats calculation
states.empty: Storage empty state showing 0 KB used

screens.layout: Clean settings groups for Storage & Privacy (100% on-device), Backup & Restore (JSON export/import), Metadata extraction settings, and About NexusLink.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement NexusLink as an Expo React Native Android app using Editorial Mobile LIGHT personality (Playfair Display and DM Sans, warm off-white and terracotta palette). Ensure 100% on-device persistence (AsyncStorage/SQLite), Android Sharesheet intent handler for link capture, automatic metadata extractor (title, description, domain, preview image), folders, tags, search, and full CRUD link detail/edit flow. Every screen must handle loading, empty, and error states cleanly with touch targets >= 44x44pt and safe area insets respected.
